_comment: Illustrative off-chain view of an ERC-8004 Validation Registry entry (fields mirror contracts/ValidationRegistryUpgradeable.sol). Same JOIN as entry.authorized.json, but for a mandate act signed AFTER the principal revoked the mandate. This is the delta the ERC-8004 off-chain-delegation sketch (issue #77) lacks: a revocation lifecycle. The referenced envelope carries the revocation record, and the offline verifier returns NOT AUTHORIZED — so the validation entry's own evidence proves authority did NOT hold at act time.

_meta.requestHash_algorithm: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of the mandate envelope at requestURI (opaque bytes32 to the registry — see entry.authorized.json _meta).

_response_note: response 0 (illustrative, validator-defined) for a NOT-AUTHORIZED verdict — the act was signed after revocation. The offline verifier proves this deterministically; re-run the verify command to reproduce the ✗ NOT AUTHORIZED / flag post_revocation verdict.
